text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон wins the Arima Kinen!
Нарита Брайан
has also shown everyone the
full extent of her
drive, and the whole
venue is roaring over the
performances
from both the Queen of the
Amazons
and the Beast.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон relishes in her victory
while Narita
Brian congratulates her. She
lets out a joyous yell
at the conclusion
of their one-on-one.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
On the way home, Нарита Брайан says that
Hishi
Amazon has a passion in her that
makes her want
to keep on going. The
two acknowledge each
other's abilities
and vow to compete again.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She'll win any one-on-one that comes
her way!
That's the kind of burning
passion Хиши Амадзон
harbors within her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
